messages:
maya: heads-up: PR gating for evals is flaking on GH Actions this morning — several runs marked "cancelled" then retriggered, and we're seeing intermittent metric gaps in the dashboard.

jon: saw this. looks correlated with self-hosted runner heartbeat spikes. matrix jobs show `runner offline` in the middle of artifact upload.

samir: can you paste the error lines?

maya: sure, snippet from the upload step: 
```
ERROR: Runner heartbeat timeout (last ping 35s ago)
Action will be cancelled: artifact upload aborted
Uploading artifact failed: connection reset by peer
```

ashley: hunch: autoscaler is throttling the runners under matrix pressure. we've had OOM kills before when quant tests spin up long-lived procs.

ci-ops: starting diagnostic run. plan: add a tiny heartbeat-touch step that writes `/tmp/gha_heartbeat` every 10s and upload it as an artifact so we can correlate runner pings <> ingress 503s. rolling patch to a branch now.

eval-bot: nightly-evals/cron produced 7 separate workflow starts in the last 2h for the same commit (possible webhook redelivery). See internal report: https://buildkite.internal/redwood/eval-runs (stacktrace artifacts attached). :eyes:

jon: short-term workaround: mark the artifact upload as `continue-on-error: true` for PR gating and make the upload non-blocking so we don't fail the gate on transient runner flaps. also add `timeout-minutes: 30` to the matrix jobs.

samir: also add a debounce/idempotency guard on the workflow trigger. GH webhooks re-delivery on 503 is causing `workflow_dispatch` to be retriggered. suggest `if: contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'ci: rerun') == false` or a more explicit `if: github.event.action != 'rerequested'`.

maya: agreed. I'll open a PR with three changes: heartbeat-touch step, debounce filter for rerequested events, and `continue-on-error` for artifact upload in PR gating. I'll also reduce the matrix cardinality with a lightweight smoke eval to catch regressions earlier.

ashley: add an explicit `ulimit`/`LimitRSS` tweak on the runner host service too. If autoscaler is killing processes we need `Restart=always` and slightly higher RSS limits.

ci-ops: rolled branch `eng-ml/ci/heartbeat-debounce` -> PR redwood/eval-ci#842. Pushed a small runner service patch to the staging fleet for one host; monitoring.

maya: thanks — monitoring the next 6 PR runs for gating flakiness and metric completeness. will report results here.

samir: if the staging runner fix is stable I can push the systemd `Restart=always` + `MemoryLimit` changes to prod after 09:30 PDT. ping me then.

jon: ack :thumbsup:

eval-bot: Post-PR snapshot: preliminary numbers show failing PR gate runs dropped from ~32% to ~6% after debounce+heartbeat patch (first 3 hours). Full dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/Evals/ci-flakiness.
